title: What is TAVR - Heart Valve Replacement? Is TAVR safe? (Hindi) | Artemis Campaign for Heart Care
description: #HeartCare #HeartToHeart#TAVI #TAVR #DrAmitKumarChaurasia #Artemis #ArtemisHospitals #Cardiology #CardiacCare #HeartDiseases #HealthyHeart #Healthcare #Health #HeartValve Importance of Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement (TAVR/TAVI) Radio Dwarka in association with Artemis Hospitals, Gurugram has started a series to create awareness on Heart Diseases and Cardiac Care. asr.full_text: Namaskar Viewers Welcome to our series Heart to Heart We are doing this series for heart awareness and cardiac care In this series we have Dr. Amit Kumar Chaurasia Dr. Chaurasia is Senior Consultant & Chief of TAVR & Structural Heart Disease Program at Artemis Hospital Doc, Welcome this Radio Door Sir, TAVR or TAVI is basically a term but it is for valve replacement and for implant so, we will tell you actually what is the procedure Full form of TAVR is Trans-catheter Aortic Valve Replacement Heart has 4 main valve Out of which 2 are in right side and 2 in left side Out of left side 2 valve First valve is mitral valve which maintains flow between heart 2 chambers Second valve is aortic valve which maintains blood flow from heart 1 to the entire body Like a door It opens smoothly and the blood flow remains good If there is any problem in the door, the blood does not flow forward Over a period of time decreases in volume in the body After the aging period, calcium deposits happen which creates no volume in aortic of a pelvic area This leads to the loss of the ability to collect blood from the heart This is known as iota stenosis Now Early stage of surgery was done opening entire chest Calcium is being deposited means this is very present in aged population In aged population means in 70-70 years Surgery is also difficult So you can guess among 40% people were suffering in such condition In 70 years surgery becomes also very difficult But take 40 percentage of patients who did without surgery Now we have option called TAVER and TAVI transcaved valvular replacement In which surgical risk has reduced We do not open completely We just need to go through one small vein and change the valve patient stays in hospital maximum 3 days after that goes to home conventional surgery you see patient comes there are lot of investigations surgery of chest, also ventilator stays for long time 6 day minimum hospital stay after that they have to recover whole 2 days for six months in these procedures there is a minimum hospital stay of eight days after that mean you have to recover whole for two months here in three days you are at home and you are working but this procedure is more suitable for old ages because there is no surgery available. and there is no patient not wanting to have surgeries or there are other patients who need other surgeries, but there are many patients who are not able to get a surgical done due to valve problem therefore mostly we usually prefer this subprociendo In addition, there is one valve inside ,which is put there where do we install it? So sir, how is this function ? valve is used inside an electrical valve you have to work with other valve so what is its function it is like a metal tube inside it the valves seat means they are made so you go inside the old natural valve and open this metal so what happens The leaflet of old valve gets into the metal It means the old valve's leaflet is put outside the metal and the new leaflet inside the metal starts to function So what it means is that we didn't do any work it just works It's a very simple procedure specially in cases where they can't make a change or in aged patients. If I could ask one more thing about functional and how was it succeeded at the same time? Yes, I know this procedure. I started this procedure in 2013. At that time, I used to work in a group. At that time i used to go to Europe at that time in 2007 when i had 2 followup in me this procedure started from 2004 by 2013 there were few centers in world when i started BA there were 2 patients that time who were 84 years old till the time i was in Europe, I registered the patients till 2016 and they were coming for surgery after they were not moving. Those patients who were not able to move at all after surgery, after surgery for your in which type the valve going to be replaced or implant Doctor sahab told us everything and we hope you will find all this video useful goodbye from you, keep on listening the Radio Dwarka

surgical risk has reduced We do not open completely We just need to go through one small vein and change the valve patient stays in hospital maximum 3 days after that goes to home conventional surgery you see patient comes there are lot of investigations surgery of chest, also ventilator stays for long time 6 day minimum hospital stay after that they have to recover whole 2 days for six months in these procedures there is a minimum hospital stay of eight days after that mean you have to recover whole for two months here in three days you are at home and you are working but this procedure is more suitable for old ages because there is no surgery available. and there is no patient not wanting to have surgeries or there are other patients who need other surgeries, but there are many patients who are not able to get a surgical done due to valve problem therefore mostly we usually prefer this subprociendo In addition, there is one valve inside ,which is put there where do we install it? So sir, how is this function ? valve is used inside an electrical valve you have to work with other valve so what is its function it is like a metal tube inside it the valves seat means they are made so you go inside the old natural valve and open this metal so what happens The leaflet of old valve gets into the metal It means the old valve's leaflet is put outside the metal and the new leaflet inside the metal starts to function So what it means is that we didn't do any work it just works It's a very simple procedure specially in cases where they can't make a change or in aged patients. If I

could ask one more thing about functional and how was it succeeded at the same time? Yes, I know this procedure. I started this procedure in 2013. At that time, I used to work in a group. At that time i used to go to Europe at that time in 2007 when i had 2 followup in me this procedure started from 2004 by 2013 there were few centers in world when i started BA there were 2 patients that time who were 84 years old till the time i was in Europe, I registered the patients till 2016 and they were coming for surgery after they were not moving.
